intended_object: An auxiliary fresh "dummy" variable used in an alpha-renaming step of a machine-generated nominal proof certificate (docstring: "Checked nominal proof certificate identified upstream as `nb095_alpha_dummy_350`"). It is the first variable not free in two specific syntactic class terms.
explanation: The body applies `freshVar` to the union of the free-variable sets of two specific syntactic class expressions built from earlier dummy variables. That picks a bound-variable name that avoids capture during alpha-conversion in a generated proof. This is a bookkeeping device inside a proof-certificate pipeline. It does not correspond to any mathematical object from the literature, so there is nothing to compare with a standard notion, and Mathlib has no counterpart.
